items.title: Could Schneider Rail Deal Alter The Investment Case For Norfolk Southern Stock?
items.summary: Norfolk Southern and Schneider National previously announced a US intermodal agreement that combines Schneider's 35 years of intermodal operations and assets with Norfolk Southern's eastern rail network and infrastructure projects across key hubs. The pairing of Schneider's company-owned chassis, containers and dray fleet with Norfolk Southern's 22 state intermodal network directly targets truck-to-rail conversion and more reliable long haul freight options for shippers. items.title: Norfolk Southern (NSC) Dropped, So What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
items.summary: Why Norfolk Southern Stock Is Back in Focus After the Schneider Deal Norfolk Southern (NSC) just signed a new agreement with Schneider National that links Schneider's intermodal assets and dray fleet with Norfolk Southern's eastern U.S. rail network and ongoing terminal projects. The arrangement targets rising demand for intermodal freight and relies on Schneider's tractors, containers, and more than 60 rail hubs, together with Norfolk Southern's 22-state footprint and recent infrastructure...
